critical_code_review_comments: All subscription and push notification endpoints properly require admin role (403 for non-admin)
PayPal payment APIs are correctly MOCKED - require existing payment_id to create orders
Subscription plans auto-initialize with correct pricing (Free: ₪0, Pro: ₪99, Premium: ₪199)

subscription_plans_api.notes: Returns 3 plans (free: ₪0, pro: ₪99, premium: ₪199) with features list

my_subscription_api.notes: Returns current user subscription, defaults to free tier

create_subscription_api.notes: Creates subscription, handles duplicate subscription check

admin_subscriptions_list.notes: Returns subscriptions with stats (total_active, total_pro, total_premium), supports filtering by status/tier

push_preferences_get.notes: Returns user notification preferences with defaults

admin_push_send.notes: Sends notifications to all/providers/users, creates in-app notifications

admin_push_history.notes: Returns push notification history with sent_at, target, recipients_count

paypal_create_order.notes: MOCKED - requires existing payment_id, returns mock order IDs

paypal_capture_order.notes: MOCKED - requires valid order, simulates successful capture
